He began, for the first time in a decade, to compose a reply.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在墨蓝色的夜里。街道空旷，路灯把湿漉漉的柏油路照成一条条光带。远处的高楼只有零星几扇窗亮着，像深夜未阖的眼睛。清洁工的扫帚声沙沙传来，早餐铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽。出租车亮着“空车”的灯缓缓驶过，红绿灯在无人的路口固执地变换。一只流浪猫穿过巷口，影子被拉得很长。地铁入口静默着，等待几小时后的人潮。这座城市在醒来之前，先安静地呼吸着。", "w03": "• Imagine a line of dominoes: you knock over the first one, and it knocks the next, which knocks the next — each domino does one tiny job and passes the job along.\n• Recursion is when a function solves a small piece of a problem, then calls itself to solve the rest, until it reaches a case so simple it can answer it directly — that final domino is called the base case.\n• So the recipe is: do one small step, hand the rest of the work to another copy of yourself, and always have a stopping point — that's how you open Russian nesting dolls, one doll at a time, until you reach the solid one that won't open."}
